create_chat_template: create a ChatTemplate dataclass instance with role prefix/suffix mappings for a model
build_chat_prompt: build a formatted chat prompt string from a list of role-content message dicts using a template
get_chat_template: get a registered ChatTemplate instance by its string name like llama-2-chat or chatml
get_chat_template_by_model_path: get the matching ChatTemplate for a model path string by running registered matching functions
register_chat_template_matching_function: register a function that matches a model path string to a template name
